text: A Rite Pedestal holds and shows one item. Four of them around a Ritual Brazier make the **Rite Circle**, which every tablet rite needs, Spring Calling included.
A brazier's standing blessing does not need it: that only wants the seated seal and its totem.

pages.title: Draw the circle
pages.text: Brazier in the middle, four Rite Pedestals on the diagonals, chalk joining them.

pages.title: Using the circle
text: If the circle is incomplete, a tablet rite names the missing pieces and the tablet is not spent. Crouch and right-click the brazier with the Codex to see ghosts.

Tablets can wait on the pedestals. A struck redstone signal on the brazier fires the seated rite with a pedestal's tablet that matches the seal, and a comparator reads whether a pedestal is occupied. That is how you put a [rite on a clock](redstone_language).

pages.title: Voices on the cardinals
pages.text: Seat four totems of the rite's own voice on the cardinals: the rite costs a quarter less and lasts twice as long.

pages.title: The stronger circle
text: The four cardinal totems only count when they match the rite being cast, so a Water circle helps Rain Calling and Spring Calling but not Dawn Calling.
It is optional. A plain circle casts every rite at full price.
